# Memmy v1.2.7

This is the unreleased project-collaboration development line. Its final release scope and acceptance evidence will be recorded against the eventual release candidate.

## Development baseline

- Synchronize the published Memmy 1.2.6 main baseline into the existing project-collaboration line while retaining its current collaboration behavior.
- Preserve background Office runtime preparation and progress from PR #880 alongside managed TeX and Office rendering support.
- Retain the shared migration-build preparation and complete worker-backlog regression checks from PR #875.

## Versions

Desktop, Agent, Backend, and native application metadata use `1.2.7`. The Memory service, viewer, and CLI remain independently versioned at `2.1.7`.

## Release status

This document records a development baseline. It does not declare a published 1.2.7 release, completed package acceptance, or release approval. Independent review, final-candidate regression, packaging, and publication remain separate steps.
